name: Jelly QoL
description: Quality-of-life features for Jellyfin 12.1: Media Bar, filter warnings, service shortcuts, search ordering, context menus, pagination, announcements, notifications and media visibility. English and Polish.
overview: Media Hider, QoL, Media Bar, Services, Announcements and Notifications.

versions.changelog: Centered series, episode and original titles inside a bounded detail-page text block. Added responsive equal side gutters and a 64rem maximum width, while preserving wrapping and native mobile padding. Heading box sizing includes focus padding so the centered text does not overflow.

Fixed series, episode and original titles overflowing the detail ribbon with grid-based themes and nowrap subtitle styling. Scoped detail-page constraints keep grid columns inside the viewport, wrap long titles, preserve mobile padding and let controls shrink/wrap on narrow screens. Media Hider labels and group names also stay within their containers.

The outgoing Media Bar scene now animates all the way to zero opacity and is removed after its opacity transition ends. Isolated additive compositing prevents overlap darkening while preserving directional motion, overscan at both edges and the 1.4-second transition. Existing context-menu actions remain available.

Distinguished new arrivals from replacement files using persisted media baselines and logical identity matching. New titles keep generic notifications. Later updates announce added audio/subtitle languages or higher resolution only; codec, bitrate, size, naming, unchanged replacements and downgrades stay silent. Baselines survive restart, cleared history and retention. Updates and initial arrivals group separately, with per-user access checks and Seerr/library deduplication. English and Polish messages.

Fixed dark edge strips during Media Bar transitions in both directions. Kept slight directional motion and a 1.4-second crossfade, with temporary overscan covering both edges. The outgoing scene stays opaque underneath the incoming scene to prevent overlap darkening. Image readiness, rapid-navigation cancellation and reduced-motion behavior are preserved.

Random Media Bar selections now refresh every 10 minutes per account. Fixed the sliding expiry that kept postponing a reshuffle on each metadata poll. New selections prioritize available titles outside the previous set; metadata/artwork still refresh every 30 seconds and access is rechecked on every request.

Moved Remove from Continue Watching directly below playback actions and added Mark as watched underneath it. Card context menus now scroll on short screens. Fixed removed titles returning after reload by invalidating Jellyfin native persisted user queries and refreshing native item containers after a successful save. Verified persistence across full reloads and account isolation.

Added Remove from Continue Watching to the native card menu and right-click menu for partially watched movies and episodes. Clears only the signed-in account resume position, preserving library files, watched status, favorites, play count and other accounts. Polish and English home rows update immediately; failed requests leave the list unchanged.

Full Media Bar slide-list refresh includes native Jellyfin version tags for logos and backdrops, all rendered metadata, inactive slide labels/preloads and trailer metadata. Stable image versions are not reloaded, and stale image callbacks cannot overwrite current content. Added per-user available season counts for series, excluding season 0, empty seasons and virtual/missing episodes.

Removed black edge overlays, backdrop blur and double-cut masks. Only the artwork fades broadly over an opaque trailer, preventing a dark seam. Widened the partial-opacity region to about 20% of bar width. Simplified the bottom fade and kept the last trailer frame visible during buffering. Preserved the 30% artwork shift, 35–55% arc and existing timing.

Aligned complementary artwork/player masks to prevent backdrop overlap. Left-side blur and opaque darkening stop at the trailer boundary; a narrow translucent dark veil gently overlaps and fades out along the player edge. Increased animated backdrop shift to 30% of bar width and aligned mobile mask geometry.

Fixed 1.4-second slide/crossfade transitions retain outgoing media until artwork is ready; removed duration control. Curved trailer boundary from 35% top to 55% bottom, matching backdrop transparency, animated 20% left shift over one second, header underlay. Added per-account default trailer sound, off by default, with muted autoplay fallback. Seerr skips stale movies and season episodes already available in Jellyfin, with diagnostics and native availability tracking.

Automatic full-length trailers hold slide rotation through loading, playback and buffering. Stateful sound and play/stop icons, hidden YouTube controls and best-effort caption suppression. Right-side video with curved dark/blur mask, soft transparent bottom and reduced library spacing. User Appearance retains only Enable trailers in Media Bar; all other appearance/source/delay settings are administrator-controlled.

Expanded Media Bar appearance: full-width banner or framed card, backdrop crop and height, optional logos/ratings/genres/buttons/indicators, synopsis lines, fade timing, touch swipes and preloading. Optional per-account appearance overrides in Appearance; global admin on/off and title selection retained. Added trailer source, manual/autoplay, delay and sound controls; fixed YouTube iframe SDK integration.

Added an isolated Home-only Media Bar with administrator-controlled on/off, title source, count, rotation, synopsis and compact height. Per-account trailer opt-in in Appearance; muted local and YouTube previews. Respects library access and Media Hider, avoids detected existing bars. Profile categories: Appearance, Notifications, Notification history.
Renamed the bulk notification action to Mark as read (Oznacz jako przeczytane). The read and clear-history buttons in the bell panel now share one horizontal row, including narrow mobile layouts.

Added per-account Appearance settings to hide all or selected header library shortcuts and show Favorites as a heart beside the notification bell. The profile menu uses the supplied user-attributes icon at its original 24px size. Notification panels close on outside clicks. Added Clear notification history for the current account only, preserving preferences and future notifications. Removed the premature Seerr-account-link notice.
Removed the About section from the profile settings panel. Notifications and History remain available.

The notification bell now opens a compact, non-blocking panel in the top-right corner. Removed automatic notification popups on entry, navigation and new events. The bell only displays the unread count and notifications; profile settings remain separate. Removed the automatic-popup switch while preserving account preferences and history.

Fixed the notification bell pushing the avatar below the other header buttons. The bell now lives in the header actions row instead of the avatar container, with a bounded 44px size and no outer margins. Preserves the notification-save fixes from 1.6.1.

Fixed a false notification-save error: successful HTTP 204 responses are no longer parsed as JSON. Administrator settings and account notification preferences now display success correctly. Empty optional account mappings are accepted. Existing settings and webhook secrets are preserved.

Added optional completed Seerr request webhooks and Jellyfin library notifications, with exact media matching and native library/Media Hider access checks. Profile settings popup, account preferences, grouped episodes, bell, history, unread state, once-per-account popups and one-hour reminders. Both sources enabled by default; administrator activation required. Includes webhook setup, secret rotation, account mappings, diagnostics and Test preview.

Added a native Jelly QoL settings shortcut in the administrator sidebar. Announcement Test previews unsaved fields without saving, counting views or changing dismissal state. Redesigned responsive announcement cards with clearer typography, icons, bullet details and a prominent action button.

Blinking filter icon without toolbar text. Added configurable header shortcuts, native right-click menus, Movies/Series/Seerr search ordering with empty-section handling, toast icons, top/bottom pagination, optional scheduled announcements. Four settings tabs: Media Hider, QoL, Services, Announcements. Names and URLs are saved in server configuration; no personal defaults are bundled.

Renamed to Jelly QoL. Added live active-filter warnings for Jellyfin 12.1, optional animation, separate Media Hider and QoL tabs, and a simple text-only thumbnail. Existing visibility settings, groups and schedules are preserved.

Optional user groups, independent one-time reveal date and time for each group, administrator-only fallback without groups, simple catalog thumbnail, and in-memory File Transformation integration. Existing title settings are preserved.
